svg.title: Ongoing / One API, two clients
svg.desc: The CLI and the browser are peers: both read the same entries endpoint and send the same validated patches through the same routes, behind the same gate. Since Phase 4 the browser builds the query string the CLI builds, out of the same shared functions.. Architecture structure.
